binding_identity.how_derived: semantic_hash over a seed containing the binding request material, the applicability receipt replay identity, the receipt id, the F8 rule hash, the admitted source set, and the currentness result
covers: the exact binding request (id, service request identity, candidate class, service, target use, release, bound permission refs, mode, requested source, currentness claim, requested purpose)
the applicability receipt's replay identity and receipt id
the exact F8 model rule hash
binding_identity.verify_api: verify_service_f8_scope_binding_replay re-derives the binding from (request, receipt, rule, currentness_result) and refuses with BINDING_REPLAY_MISMATCH unless both the replay identity and the full material are identical
binding_identity.court_proof: test_binding_replay_is_stable_and_re_derivation_must_match re-derives and asserts both identity and material equality

provenance_chain_carried_into_binding_ma: per-source admission_provenance rows: source_universe_ref, release_identity_ref, admitted, bound_to_requested_release, admission_authority_ref, admission_provenance_refs, public_typed_state
per-source non_admitted_source_states rows: source_universe_ref, applicability_decision, public_typed_state, reason_code

provenance_fail_closed_at_evaluation.rule_replay: the F8 model rule presented at evaluation must have the SAME rule_hash the binding was made against, else BINDING_RULE_REPLAY_MISMATCH. The binder validates one exact rule and never re-points it.
provenance_fail_closed_at_evaluation.receipt_replay: when the receipt is supplied to evaluate_bound_positioned_subject_possibility, its replay identity must equal the identity recorded at binding time, else BINDING_REPLAY_MISMATCH; and its receipt id must match, else BINDING_RECEIPT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH. A receipt mutated after binding is therefore detected.
provenance_fail_closed_at_evaluation.court_proof: test_receipt_mutated_after_binding_is_detected_at_evaluation builds a second receipt over the same class with a different admitted set, shows the replay identities differ, and shows evaluation refuses.
provenance_fail_closed_at_evaluation.when_receipt_omitted: omitting the receipt does not weaken the binding; it only means the call re-validates the binding's own recorded identity rather than re-deriving it from a receipt. This is stated explicitly in the docstring.

admission_provenance_not_a_selection_rea.position: the binding carries ADMISSION PROVENANCE, never a selection reason
admission_provenance_not_a_selection_rea.why: no selection occurs. Recording why a source was chosen over another would either fabricate a selection or misrepresent an independent per-source determination as a comparative judgement. This is the HQ204-derived position and the adopted applicability owner states it as well (no_selection_reason_record_exists = true).
admission_provenance_not_a_selection_rea.each_admitted_entry_carries: the exact positive admission authority ref plus admission_provenance_refs and its exact release identity
admission_provenance_not_a_selection_rea.court_proof: test_binding_carries_exact_receipt_replay_identity_and_admission_provenance asserts the provenance is present and non-empty, and asserts a non-None admission authority

determinism_evidence.variation_applied: runs 1 and 2 with PYTHONHASHSEED=0; run 3 with PYTHONHASHSEED=12345 to demonstrate order-independence rather than a lucky fixed seed
determinism_evidence.conclusion: the binding's identity and the courts are deterministic and hash-seed independent

no_silent_widening_or_narrowing.binding_never_widens: an F8 model rule declaring a source outside the admitted set is refused with F8_RULE_SOURCE_OUTSIDE_ADMITTED_SET. The binder narrows eligibility; it never widens the F8 source scope.
no_silent_widening_or_narrowing.binding_never_completes_the_rule: in EXHAUSTIVE mode a rule that does not span every admitted source is refused with F8_RULE_SOURCE_SET_NOT_EXHAUSTIVE. The binder never adds a source to the F8 rule on the caller's behalf.
no_silent_widening_or_narrowing.binding_never_edits_inputs: no conditioner, geometry, uncertainty, raw support, walkback step or proxy authority is read or written; the court proves the read-side by AST scan
no_silent_widening_or_narrowing.pass_through_is_by_identity: the court asserts out.query_ref equals the caller's own q.ref, that the evidence object is the same object with unchanged retained_conditioner_ids, and that exact_geometry equals the pre-materialized geometry

coverage_honesty_in_replay.why_that_hardening: exposing the admitted SET is an exhaustive claim. Enforcing COMPLETE only in EXHAUSTIVE_UNRANKED_SET would have let a caller bind a SINGLE_SOURCE_VALIDATION binding over an INCOMPLETE class and then call expose_unranked_admitted_source_set to obtain a partial set as if it were the admissible set. The court pins this exact laundering attempt and it refuses.
coverage_honesty_in_replay.incomplete_coverage_still_permits: validating one known-admitted source (power 1), which is the narrow truthful capability

currentness_handling_in_replay.default: CURRENTNESS_NOT_REQUESTED; the binding asserts nothing about currency
currentness_handling_in_replay.never: infers currency from applicability; a current source may still be NOT_APPLICABLE and an APPLICABLE source may still be EXPIRED_OR_STALE
